name: Western Caucasus
story: The Western Caucasus is a western region of the North Caucasus in Southern Russia, extending from the Black Sea to Mount Elbrus. It includes a UNESCO World Heritage Site with varied habitats ranging from lowlands to glaciers. The area features large areas of undisturbed mountain forest and tall Nordmann fir trees.
matters: It is a protected natural place that shelters high mountain species of plants, many of which are endemic. It also includes a Persian leopard reintroduction centre and is the place of origin and reintroduction of the Caucasian wisent.
